GDX residual-reversal strategy — in-sample report

Summary

Status: no_candidate_passed_validation_filters. No shortlisted config passed the hard filters on validation. The primary below is the best by fewest failures and composite rank, and does not meet the stated requirements; treat OOS results for it as a test, not a deployment.

Primary: BEST_BIC|L250|m3|k0.5|H5|B|est   alternates: BEST_BIC|L250|m3|k0.5|H5|B|rev, BEST_BIC|L250|m3|k0.5|H10|B|est

  • Development net Sharpe 0.88 (neighbourhood median 0.46); validation net Sharpe -0.32. Validation failed filters: f_halves, f_years.
  • Model: two_stage — Daily lowest-BIC factor model over all 31 combinations, specified after validation was seen; validation results are a logged deviation, judge on OOS only. Filters: both halves positive, >= 70% years positive, every month..
  • Deflated Sharpe ratio (N = 169,200 configs tried on this data): 0.090; placebo percentile 99.2; sign-flip Sharpe -0.97; bootstrap 95% CI [0.05, 1.70].
  • Walk-forward of the selection rule 2011–2021: stitched net Sharpe 0.45, 4 distinct configs in 9 years (red flag: False).
  • Frozen 2026-10-12T20:23:07+00:00 at commit 6a5c59d4a6 (dirty: False); data gold_etf_factor_regression.xlsx sha256 4aa64eee1a96….

All returns are daily GDX excess returns on 1x notional (self-financing overlay), net of 2 bps per unit traded unless stated. Signals are formed and executed at the close of day t. Development 2011-10-10 → 2016-12-30, validation 2017-01-03 → 2021-12-31.

Is the edge concentrated on day 1?

At the primary's k=0.5: cumulative edge after day 1 is +11.9 bps (dev) / +5.1 bps (val); after day 2 +18.7 / -6.8 bps; after day 10 -16.5 / -70.8 bps. The day-1 concentration hypothesis is not supported: the edge is small on day 1 and peaks around day 2 in development, then decays.
